problem
In every bazaar in Pakistan, small clothing sellers have good stock.
But getting one shirt online means photos, background removal, captions, sizes and prices.
Hours of work, for every single item.
intro
This is Vestire AI Listing Studio.
One photo. A full listing.
upload
The seller adds one photo, straight from the shop counter.
No need to clean the background. Just tap the garment.
generate
Tap Generate.
Meta's Segment Anything model, in its compressed SlimSAM version, cuts the garment out right inside the browser.
At the same time, Meta Llama 4 Scout, an open-weights model, looks at the photo and writes the listing.
On this live run, the whole pipeline finished in under twenty seconds.
gallery
Back comes a clean cut-out, a white studio shot, and a flat-lay scene.
All of them use the seller's real garment, not an AI copy.
Type a colour, and you get a colour preview too.
form
Everything is editable.
If a risky claim like "original" slips into the title, the app flags it before anything is published.
Descriptions in English and Roman Urdu, captions, hashtags, and a size chart are all ready to edit.
And the price is only a suggestion. The seller decides.
share
Share it to WhatsApp in one tap, or download the full listing pack.
Images, captions, listing data, and a CSV file, ready for the store's import.
draft
For Vestire stores, there is also an optional Send to Vestire setting.
It is off by default, and it creates the product as a hidden draft, so the owner checks it before it goes live.
end
Hours of work, in about a minute. Free to use.
